findings.title: Table-widget feature flag renders an empty table instead of the widget data
findings.body: When the organization has the `use-table-widget-visualization` feature, `tableResultComponent` renders `TableWidgetVisualization` with hard-coded `columns={[]}` and `tableData={{data: [], meta: {fields: {}, units: {}}}}`, discarding `result.data`, `result.meta`, `fields`, field aliases, custom renderers, and the widget title. Every dashboard table widget for a flagged organization therefore shows an empty table rather than its queried data. The real table result should be converted and passed through, or the flag branch should not replace the working table yet.

findings.title: Error events can be paired with the wrong nodestore payload
findings.body: `fetch_error_details` builds `node_ids` from `error_ids` but then pairs them with `zip(error_ids, events.values())`. `nodestore.backend.get_multi` returns a mapping keyed by node id, not a sequence guaranteed to align positionally with `error_ids`; if an event is missing or the mapping order differs, an error ID is combined with another event's title/message/timestamp (the `if data is not None` check does not fix mis-pairing). This corrupts the chronological error context sent to Seer. Look up each payload by its generated node id instead of zipping values.

findings.title: Hidden span attributes are only hidden while searching
findings.body: The new `HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES` list (`is_segment`, `project_id`, `received`) is applied only inside the branch that runs when `searchQuery` is non-empty. With no search text the function returns `sortAttributes(attributes)` unfiltered, so the supposedly hidden attributes are still displayed by default and only disappear after the user types a query. The hidden-attribute filter should be applied to the sorted list in both paths.

findings.title: Mixed age/timestamp validation misses falsy-but-present values
findings.body: `validate_timestamp` and `validate_age` check `self.initial_data.get("age")` / `get("timestamp")` for truthiness. A report containing `timestamp` plus `age: 0` (a valid, present age) passes validation because `0` is falsy, violating the serializer's own rule that the two fields must not coexist and letting ambiguous Working-Draft/Editor's-Draft reports through. Presence should be tested with `is not None` / `in` rather than truthiness.

findings.title: Assemble analytics are recorded for rejected and feature-disabled requests
findings.body: `analytics.record("preprod_artifact.api.assemble", ...)` runs before the `organizations:preprod-artifact-assemble` feature check and before request-body validation, so 404 feature-disabled responses and 400 invalid requests are counted as assemble events. This inflates adoption/usage metrics with requests that never assembled an artifact. The event should be recorded only after the feature gate (and ideally after validation succeeds), or carry a field distinguishing rejected requests.
